Eight women at different stages of pregnancy stand in a line on a hillside path leading to a health centre.
A nurse measures a woman's blood pressure while the woman holds a new pregnancy card in her lap.
A nurse weighs a pregnant woman on a standing scale while the woman's card waits on the desk.
A woman raises a hand slightly to ask a question while a nurse leans in to listen.
A health worker gently pricks a pregnant woman's finger while she looks away calmly.
A nurse hands a pregnant woman a small packet of tablets and holds up two fingers.
A woman sits in a private room with a counsellor; her partner waits outside on a bench.
A nurse talks quietly with a pregnant woman alone in a consulting room; a second panel shows a man getting an injection at the health centre.
A newborn wrapped in a kitenge cloth gets a vaccine in the thigh while the mother holds him.
A woman puts her pregnancy card safely into a cloth pouch.
A heavily pregnant woman steps into the health centre for the first time and a nurse greets her warmly.
A woman walks back to the health centre on a weekday morning, carrying her card.
A nurse reads a pregnancy card and points to an empty box, smiling.
A nurse holds the hands of an anxious pregnant woman in a welcoming room.
A pregnant woman sits in the shade of her doorway with a cup of tea, looking calm, while children play in the yard.
A young pregnant woman sips from a cup while her mother grates fresh ginger root into a small pot over a charcoal stove.
A pregnant woman props a folded blanket under the head end of her sleeping mat while a small plate of food sits nearby.
At night, a pregnant woman sitting on her bed pulls her toes back with one hand while rubbing her calf with the other.
Two pregnant women walk together along a flat path between tea fields in the cool morning.
A pregnant woman at a market stall chooses avocados, beans and green vegetables while holding a water bottle.
A woman with a mild grimace touches her stomach while talking with a nurse.
A pregnant woman in a bright wrap sits on a bench outside her brick house on a green hillside, showing her phone to her husband and her mother-in-law.
In daylight, a husband helps his pregnant wife, who holds a cloth, toward an ambulance stopped on the road by their house; a neighbour carries her bag.
A woman sits holding her head with one hand while her sister ties a wrap around her shoulders and points down the path toward the health centre.
A pregnant woman lies on a mat inside a simple room while her husband kneels beside her and a community health worker in a vest arrives at the door.
A woman shows her swollen hand and face to her mother, who has put on her headscarf, ready to walk with her to the health centre in daylight.
A woman standing by a water jerrycan looks down in surprise at a wet patch on her wrap, then (second panel) walks with her sister toward the health centre.
A woman bent over with one hand on her lower belly is helped along a path by an older woman.
A pregnant woman talks with a neighbour who drives a moto-taxi; he nods and saves her number in his phone.
A woman takes a tablet with a cup of water at breakfast, sitting on a low stool in her kitchen.
A healthy pregnant woman carries a basket of beans and greens home from the market.
A woman puts a tablet packet into a tin on a high shelf while a toddler plays on the floor.
A nurse gives a pregnant woman an injection in the upper arm; the woman smiles at the baby on her lap from a previous birth.
A woman pulls an old, folded vaccine card from a box of family papers.
Two small panels: the same woman getting an injection, first with a small bump and then with a bigger bump.
A woman puts her vaccine card into a plastic sleeve while a nurse nods (no readable writing).
A woman rubs her upper arm and laughs with a friend on the walk home.

Go now if you cannot keep any drink down, pass little or dark urine, or feel dizzy.

fr.text:
